Callout.Name: Armed Robbery - Off Licence
Callout.Message: Armed robbery in progress at an off licence.
Callout.Advisory: One male with a handgun, staff inside, no shots fired yet.

Lines.Briefing: Armed robbery in progress. He is still inside and the staff are still in there with him.
Lines.Approach: One male, handgun, in the off licence now. Get there before he leaves.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
